remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Edition 7/10. First modeled in clay in New York. O'Keeffe wrote: "All day I was at Mary Gallery's working on my sculpture" (O'Keeffe to Maria Chabot, 4 March 1946). See cat. nos. 1123–1132. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
